title: How Much Does LLM Optimisation Cost for Small Businesses? (UK Prices, 2026)
meta_title: How Much Does LLM Optimisation Cost? UK Prices 2026
meta_description: UK LLM optimisation (GEO) costs £0–£100/mo DIY, £89–£400 on a plan, £1,100–£3,800 with an agency. See what each tier includes and what to budget.

faq.q: How much does GEO cost for a small business in the UK?
faq.a: Most UK small businesses pay between £89 and £400 a month for a productised SEO and GEO plan. Traditional agency retainers cost about £1,100–£3,800 a month, and DIY with tools costs £0–£100 a month.

faq.q: Is LLM optimisation the same as SEO?
faq.a: No, but they overlap. SEO aims to rank pages on Google, while LLM optimisation aims to get your brand named in AI answers. Both rely on clear content, structured data and trusted mentions, so doing them together is cheaper than paying for each separately.

faq.q: What is LLM search optimisation called?
faq.a: It goes by several names: GEO (generative engine optimisation), AEO (answer engine optimisation), LLMO (large language model optimisation) and AI SEO. They describe the same practice.

faq.q: How long does LLM optimisation take to work?
faq.a: Technical fixes and structured data can be picked up within weeks, as AI tools that search the web live (Perplexity, ChatGPT search, Gemini) read new pages quickly. Becoming a consistent recommendation usually takes three to six months of content and mentions.

faq.q: Can I do LLM optimisation myself?
faq.a: Yes. Allowing AI crawlers, adding schema, writing answer-first pages and collecting reviews cost little beyond your time. Most owners hire help when they need regular content and monthly tracking across several AI platforms.

faq.q: Why do US price guides quote such high prices?
faq.a: They quote US agency retainers for US businesses, usually $1,500–$5,000 a month. UK productised plans are cheaper because they offer fixed deliverables instead of open-ended agency hours.

faq.q: How do I know if ChatGPT recommends my business?
faq.a: Ask it the questions your customers ask, in a fresh chat, and note who it names. A proper plan tracks dozens of these prompts across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity every month and reports your share of mentions against competitors.
